title: Sindhu Reaches French Open Final, Falls to An Se Young
indian_angle: PV Sindhu's runner-up finish marks her best-ever showing at the French Open, showcasing her return to top form.
summary: PV Sindhu put up a valiant fight in the French Open 2026 final, winning the first game against World No.1 An Se Young before eventually going down. This performance marks her best result at the tournament.

title: BAI Forms New Athletes Committee for Player Representation
indian_angle: The formation of the BAI Athletes Committee provides a dedicated platform for Indian players to voice their concerns and contribute to policy-making.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee on October 2, 2026, aiming to enhance player representation and involvement in the sport's administration.

title: National Camp Underway for BWF World Junior Championships
indian_angle: India's top junior shuttlers are undergoing intensive training at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, preparing for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 is currently being held at the National Center of Excellence (NCE) in Guwahati, bringing together India's promising young badminton talent.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Concludes in Guwahati, Raipur
indian_angle: The successful completion of the BAI Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course across two national centers signifies a commitment to elevating coaching standards in India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) successfully conducted its Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14 to 23, 2026, to upgrade coaching skills.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system aims to enhance competitive play and player development in India's junior domestic badminton circuit.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories to promote competitive play.
